document.download.description: Link to the original file of a converted document.

document.pages.description: Number of pages of a converted document.

document.preview.description: Link to the rendered preview of a converted document.

entity.application.description: Label of the application an entity belongs to.

entity.attributes.description: Heading of the block of declared properties of an entity page.

entity.breadcrumb.description: Accessible name of the breadcrumb of an entity page, space then folders then page.

entity.changed.description: Frame around the relative date of the last change of a note, such as nine days ago.

entity.confidence.description: Confidence of an inferred link, as a percentage between 0 and 1.

entity.correction.description: Question before the edit link in the footer of an entity page.

entity.declaredAtTop.defaultMessage: Declared at the top of the file.
entity.declaredAtTop.description: Note under the declared properties of an entity page, saying where they come from.

entity.domain.description: Label of the domain an entity belongs to.

entity.edit.description: Link to the edit page of the note on its forge.

entity.mentions.description: Heading of the mentions panel of an entity page.

entity.mentionsCount.description: Number of mentions of an entity, with the plural handled by the message.

entity.neighbourPages.description: Number of pages of the neighbourhood, after the line that unfolds it.

entity.neighbours.description: Heading of the one-hop neighbourhood of an entity.

entity.onThisPage.description: Heading of the table of contents of an entity page, one entry per section of the note.

entity.otherAttributes.description: Heading of the section listing the frontmatter keys the profile does not declare for the type.

entity.otherPages.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# other page} other {# other pages}}
entity.otherPages.description: Node of the tree of the space standing for the pages of a long folder it leaves out.

entity.relatedTo.description: Heading of the list of entities linked to the current one.

entity.seeNeighbourhood.description: Line of the right panel that unfolds the neighbourhood of the page.

entity.showLess.description: Button that collapses an expanded list.

entity.showMore.description: Button that expands a truncated list.

entity.sources.description: Heading of the list of sources an entity comes from.

entity.spaceTree.description: Accessible name of the tree of the space in the left column of an entity page.

entity.status.description: Label of the lifecycle status of an entity.

entity.type.description: Label of the type of an entity.

footer.builtWith.description: Optional discreet mention of the tool in the footer.

home.browse.description: Keyboard help under the live results of a search field, after the arrow keys.

home.datesNote.defaultMessage: The dates come from the history of the repositories, so they are always right.
home.datesNote.description: Note under the spaces of the home page, saying where their dates come from.

home.documents.description: Number of documents of a space whose notes mostly stand for converted documents, on its row of the home page.

home.enterKey.description: Name of the Enter key in the keyboard help under the live results of a search field.

home.explanation.defaultMessage: Type a word of the business. If it is used anywhere in the documentation, it has a page — even if nobody has defined it yet.
home.explanation.description: Explanation under the question that heads the home page, saying that every word used has a page.

home.matches.description: Number of pages a query matches, shown in the search field of the home page as the reader types.

home.moreSpaces.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# more space, less cited} other {# more spaces, less cited}}
home.moreSpaces.description: Line folding the spaces of the home page beyond the first five, the less cited ones.

home.mostCited.description: Lead of the shortcuts of the home page, the most cited pages.

home.open.description: Keyboard help under the live results of a search field, after the Enter key.

home.pages.description: Number of pages of a space, on its row of the home page.

home.question.description: The question that heads the home page, above the search field.

home.recent.description: Heading of the home page list of the pages changed last, each with its space and its date.

home.seeResults.defaultMessage: See the {count, plural, one {# result} other {# results}}
home.seeResults.description: Link from the live results of a search field to the results page, with the number of matches.

home.spacesLead.description: After the heading of the spaces on the home page, saying that they come from the declared repositories.

home.stale.defaultMessage: A space has not moved for {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
home.stale.description: Title of the alert of the home page on a space whose newest change is older than the staleness threshold.

home.staleThreshold.defaultMessage: {space}. The alert threshold is set to {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} in the configuration.
home.staleThreshold.description: Text of the alert on a dormant space, naming the space and the threshold of the configuration in days.

home.usedIn.defaultMessage: Used in {count, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}}, never defined
home.usedIn.description: Under the title of a keyword page in the live results of a search field, with the number of documents using the expression.

index.empty.description: Notice shown when a letter of the index has no entry.

index.letters.description: Label of the letter navigation of the index.

keyword.companions.description: Heading of the panel block listing the words that accompany a keyword.

keyword.createNote.description: Call to action that opens the note template of the glossary for a keyword.

keyword.documents.description: Number of documents a keyword appears in.

keyword.factFiles.description: Label of the number of files a keyword appears in, in the panel of its page.

keyword.factOccurrences.description: Label of the number of occurrences of a keyword, in the panel of its page.

keyword.factSpaces.description: Label of the spaces a keyword appears in, in the panel of its page.

keyword.filesSummary.description: Sentence under the passages heading of a keyword page, counting the files they come from.

keyword.maybeSame.description: Heading of the panel block listing the expressions of a similar form.

keyword.noCompanion.description: Notice shown when a keyword shares no paragraph with another page.

keyword.noDefinition.description: Mark on the line under the title of a keyword page, saying that no note defines the word.

keyword.noProperty.defaultMessage: No declared property: there is no file for this word.
keyword.noProperty.description: Note under the counts of a keyword page, saying why it has no properties block.

keyword.noteWritten.defaultMessage: A note now defines this expression:
keyword.noteWritten.description: Text of the page that forwards a former keyword address to the note written since.

keyword.noticeDetail.defaultMessage: This page is built from those passages alone. If someone creates the note in the glossary, its text will take its place here and the rest of the page will not change.
keyword.noticeDetail.description: Second part of the notice of a keyword page, saying what the page is built from and what happens when a note is written.

keyword.noticeLead.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Nobody has written a definition, but # passage uses this word.} other {Nobody has written a definition, but # passages use this word.}}
keyword.noticeLead.description: First sentence of the notice of a keyword page, with the number of passages that use the word.

keyword.occurrences.description: Number of occurrences of a keyword across the corpus.

keyword.pageAt.description: Position of a passage read from a converted document, given by its page number.

keyword.passagesTitle.description: Heading of the passages of a keyword page.

keyword.relatedNote.defaultMessage: Ordered by number of passages. None is “cited”: this word has no note to carry links.
keyword.relatedNote.description: Note under the related pages of a keyword page, saying how they are ordered and why none is cited.

keyword.similarLead.defaultMessage: Expressions close in form and context. A lead, not a claim.
keyword.similarLead.description: Note under the expressions of a similar form, worded so as to assert no relation.

keyword.slideAt.description: Position of a passage read from a slide deck, given by its slide number.

keyword.terms.description: Middle step of the breadcrumb of a keyword page, between the space and the word.

keyword.undefinedExpression.description: Notice that a keyword has no note of its own yet.

keyword.usedSince.description: Line under the title of a keyword page, giving the month of the oldest file that uses the word.

keyword.whatWeKnow.description: Heading of the panel block giving the counts of a keyword.

mentions.atLine.description: Location of a mention inside a document, given by its line number.

mentions.inSection.description: Location of a mention inside a document, given by its section heading.

nav.applications.description: Navigation entry for the list of applications.

nav.domains.description: Navigation entry for the domain hierarchy.

nav.index.description: Link of the top bar to the alphabetical index.

nav.types.description: Navigation entry for the list of entity types.

related.cited.description: Prefix of a related page that writes a link to the current one.

related.clearAll.description: Link that lifts every type filter of the related pages.

related.filter.description: Placeholder of the text filter of the related pages.

related.fullList.description: Link to the fragment of every mention, offered before any script runs.

related.loadingOthers.description: Text of the button while the other related pages load.

related.noMatch.description: Notice shown when the filters of the related pages keep no page.

related.none.defaultMessage: No other page evokes this one yet.
related.none.description: Notice shown when no page cites the current one.

related.orderNote.defaultMessage: Ordered by number of passages, written and recognised alike. “Cited” marks a link present in the text.
related.orderNote.description: Note under the related pages saying how they are ordered and what the cited mark means.

related.othersUnavailable.defaultMessage: The other pages could not be loaded.
related.othersUnavailable.description: Status shown when the fragment of the related pages could not be fetched.

related.pagesOf.description: Count under the type filter, the two quoted placeholders being filled in the browser.

related.passage.description: Unit after the count of a related page holding one passage, for assistive technologies.

related.passages.description: Unit after the count of a related page holding several passages, for assistive technologies.

related.showOthers.description: Button that reveals the related pages beyond the served ones, the quoted placeholder being filled in the browser.

related.title.description: Heading of the block listing the pages that evoke the current one.

related.types.description: Button opening the type filter of the related pages.

search.activeFilters.description: Heading of the list recalling the facets selected on the search page.

search.address.description: Label of the line showing the address that replays the current search.

search.clear.description: Button that resets every facet of the search.

search.copied.description: Status shown once the address of the search is in the clipboard.

search.copyAddress.description: Button that copies the address of the current search.

search.facet.application.description: Facet that filters search results by application.

search.facet.domain.description: Facet that filters search results by domain.

search.facet.noNote.description: Facet that keeps, isolates or excludes the recurring expressions nobody defined.

search.facet.source.description: Facet that filters search results by the source repository of the note.

search.facet.type.description: Facet that filters search results by entity type.

search.facets.description: Heading of the facet filters of the search page.

search.noNote.any.description: Value of the no-note facet that keeps the noteless words among the results.

search.noNote.exclude.description: Value of the no-note facet that leaves the noteless words out.

search.noNote.only.description: Value of the no-note facet that keeps the noteless words alone.

search.noResult.description: Notice shown when a search matches nothing.

search.removeFilter.description: Accessible name of the control that lifts one selected facet of the search.

search.results.description: Number of results of a search.

site.generatedAt.description: Footer line giving the day the site was built.

site.home.description: Link to the landing page of the site.

site.index.description: Link to the alphabetical index of entries.

site.recent.description: Link of the top bar to the latest changes on the home page.

site.search.description: Label of the search field and of the search page.

site.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder shown inside the empty search field.

site.skipToContent.description: Link that jumps over the navigation to the main content.

site.spaces.description: Link of the top bar to the sources, listed as spaces on the home page.

site.todo.description: Link to the page listing the findings of the build.

site.version.description: Label preceding the version of the generated site.

time.updatedAgo.description: Frame around a relative duration rendered separately, such as three days ago.

todo.findings.description: Number of findings listed on the to-do page.

todo.severity.error.description: Severity label of a finding that fails the build.

todo.severity.info.description: Severity label of a finding given for information only.

todo.severity.warning.description: Severity label of a finding that is reported but tolerated.

todo.title.description: Heading of the page listing the findings of the build.

trail.earlier.description: Follows the number of oldest trail entries folded into one expandable entry.

trail.empty.description: Notice shown when the trail holds no page.

trail.pin.description: Button that keeps the current page in the trail.

trail.title.description: Heading of the navigation trail panel.

trail.unpin.description: Button that removes the current page from the trail.

transcript.duration.description: Label of the total duration of a transcript.

transcript.speakers.description: Heading of the list of speakers of a transcript.
